SlotSet 1 -- * SlotA Slot has A SlotSet. It must always have exactly, one, and can never have none. And there is an upper bound of at most one SlotSet.A SlotSet has some Slots. It can have none, and there is no upper bound defined.When a Slot is created, its SlotSet must be assigned. When a Slot is deleted, its SlotSet is not deleted and its list of Slots is decreased. When a SlotSet is deleted, its Slots are not deleted. They are assigned to another SlotSet.
